messages:
Ana (Design): quick design check — proposing a compact 'preview row' for alerts that shows resolved recipients and suppression provenance. mock: https://staging.redwood.app/snap/compact-preview-v1.png
Rafael (PM): users want to answer "who exactly gets pinged" without extra clicks. compactness is fine as long as the preview can surface rule-level suppression info.
Jo (Frontend): implementation idea: show first 3 resolved recipients inline, then a focusable '+N more recipients' control that expands inline. expansion lazy-loads the full breakdown including which routing rule produced each recipient. show a small badge 'via <rule>' next to recipients in compact mode.
Kai (A11y): accessibility notes: 1) collapsed/expanded control must have aria-expanded and be keyboardable. 2) when expanded, move focus into the expanded list and announce the full list via aria-live. 3) if any recipient is suppressed, prefix the item with '(Suppressed)' in the visible text and aria-label — don't rely on color.
Ana (Design): microcopy: header -> 'Alert when threshold is reached' (replace current 'Notify when threshold is met'). suppression copy -> 'Suppressed — maintenance until Jul 18, 2024 02:00 UTC'. +N copy -> '+3 more recipients' (explicit).
Jo (Frontend): sample UI payload for the dev story:
```
resolvedRecipients: [
  {endpoint: "slack:#ops", rules: ["primary-route"]},
  {endpoint: "pagerduty:infra-oncall", rules: ["p90-escalation"]},
  {endpoint: "email:infra@example.com", rules: ["backup-route"]}
]
suppression: {applies_to: "primary-route", reason: "maintenance-2024-07", end: "2024-07-18T02:00:00Z"}
```
Rafael (PM): UX question: when multiple rules create the same endpoint, do we merge rows or show separate rows per rule? merging reduces noise but hides rule-level suppression.
Ana (Design): prefer merge in compact view with a 'via ruleA + ruleB' badge. provide an explicit 'Show contributing rules' control on merged rows to expand into per-rule view. label the control '+N contributing rules' (not just '+N').
Kai (A11y): ensure the merged badge is included in the aria-label: e.g. 'Slack #ops, via primary-route and page-escalation'. expanding to rules should announce each rule and its suppression state. use role="region" and aria-live="polite" for the expanded area.
Jo (Frontend): backend note: we need an endpoint-level id to map merged UI rows and an API that can return `resolvedRecipients` with rule-level suppression metadata. infra-bot: created ticket INF-5622 for preview API.
Ana (Design): decisions summary: 1) preview shows up to 3 recipients inline + focusable '+N more recipients' 2) merged endpoints show 'via' badges; provide '+N contributing rules' control to expand rule breakdown 3) suppression text includes reason + end time and is prefixed in visible text for screenreaders 4) collapsed/expanded controls are keyboardable with aria-expanded and aria-live announcements 5) lazy-load expansions with a spinner 6) header copy changed to 'Alert when threshold is reached' — Jo to add example payload in dev story, Kai to add a11y checklist, Rafael to confirm product copy.
Kai (A11y): i'll add a short keyboard walkthrough and aria-label patterns to the ticket.
Jo (Frontend): i'll add the dev story and link INF-5622 once the API is ready.
Ana (Design): thanks — i'll update the figma and drop the link here when published. :thumbsup:
